ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: scheduled work — the work-item queue, the executor, the task contract and its signals, run records, code-work, delivery
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: authoring a task — claudinite-growth; this repo's Claudinite status — claudinite-lifecycle; rendering queue state — claudinite-single-repo-dashboard; filing, deferring and verifying work through the queue, and the request lane's task — task-flow

pitch: Gives the repo scheduled, unattended work in GitHub Actions: a queue of work items, an executor that runs each one on cadence or on demand, and a delivery lane that lands results as pull requests. Without it a repo runs no scheduled work at all. Its own task records usage and what the machinery costs. About a dozen checks keep task declarations, the queue's labels and the scheduler's structure sound.
